snippet.title: Leaks In Space | Steam Demo Trailer #steamgame #space #games #teasertrailer #gametrailers
snippet.description:
We are excited to announce that we'll be taking part in October's Next Fest 2025!
🔴 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3583820?utm_campaign=b1025

A space-sim sandbox where you Construct your spaceship, Mine resources with your droids, explore & combat across hostile space where every hit on your hull can cause fatal leaks!


------------------------------------------------------
1) Build and customize your ship with unique functional parts, equip railguns and versatile turrets. Fortify your ship with armor, shields, and radars to survive the harshest corners of space.

2) Combat space pirates and unknown entities, blow them up with damages or let pirate ships suffer from their fatal leaks.

3) Make sure your ship is pressurized, repair leaks with the help of your Droids that will prioritize healing in the middle of collecting ores for you.

4) Explore the galaxy in the Pre-Alpha Demo of Leaks in Space. It’s rough around the edges and full of holes somewhat like the ship you’ll be flying :)
